deals.evidence: The team sold for almost $1 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.
deals.headline: Michael Andlauer buys the Senators from the Melnyk estate for almost $1bn
deals.summary: Andlauer agreed to acquire the Senators for almost $1 billion (Forbes lists price paid $950M) after a Galatioto Sports Partners-run process with nine first-round bidders; the Melnyk estate kept 10%.

deals.evidence: have signed an agreement of purchase and sale for land parcels totalling approximately 11 acres at LeBreton Flats
deals.headline: Senators and NCC sign purchase agreement for ~11 acres at LeBreton Flats for a new arena
deals.summary: The NCC and Capital Sports and Development Inc., representing the Senators, signed an agreement of purchase and sale for land parcels of about 11 acres at LeBreton Flats for a new downtown events centre; price not stated.

attendance.evidence: the team averaged 16,757 per game during the 2022-23 season

name: Ottawa Senators
notes: Senators are a 1992-93 NHL expansion club (records API); the original Senators' Stanley Cups are not counted, so honours left null. Revenue, operating income and player costs are Forbes estimates in USD (Dec 2025, 2024-25); Forbes value $1.375B, debt/value 20%, gate receipts $52M, price paid $950M (2023). Valuation is Sportico's 29 Sep 2026 list ($1.55bn). Canadian Tire Centre opened January 1996 (club arena site) but its capacity and owner were not stated on a readable page. Andlauer's exact stake percentage is not stated (the estate kept 10%). Chair/governor not listed on the staff directory. No sponsor or social counts found.

owners.name: Estate of Eugene Melnyk

ownership_summary: Michael Andlauer's group acquired the Senators (and the AHL Belleville Senators) in 2023 from the estate of Eugene Melnyk for almost $1bn; the Melnyk estate retained a 10% interest. Capital Sports & Entertainment Inc. holds the club's marks.
revenue_source_name: Forbes (estimate), NHL team values, December 2025 - net of arena revenues used for debt payments
valuation_source_name: Sportico NHL team values 2026 (data file, USD millions)
